chapter.verse: Pilna in a inn lam a, a inn ding khuampi sagih phut hi.
Amah in pawi bawl dingin sa go-in leenggahzu khaihin, an nek nading sabuai bawl hi.
Khua sung mun sang khempeuh panin mi sam dingin, amah in a nasem numeite sawl a,
“Thu thei lote aw, hong pai un,” ci-in samsak a, mihaite kiangah,
“Hong pai un la, ka huansa ka an ne-in, ka bawlsa leenggahzu hong dawn un.
Thu thei lote taisanin khan’sau un la, pilna lampi zui un,” ci sak hi.
Mihaite thuhilh lecin hong maizumsak ding a, migilote thuhilh lecin hong sugawp ding hi.
Mihaite thuhilh kei in, hong mudah ding hi. Mipilte thuhilh in, hong it ding hi.
Mipilte thuhilh lecin pil semsemna-in nei ding a, thuman mite thuhilh lecin a thu theihna khang semsem ding hi.
Topa zahtakna in pilna kipatna hi a, Siangtho Pa theihna in thumuhna ahi hi.
Pilna in na khang hong khan ding a, na nuntakna hong sausak ding hi.
Pil lecin nangma phattuam nading hi a, pilna don kei lecin nangma sup nading ahi hi.
Haina in a kamtam, zumna meel thei lo numei tawh kibang a,
ama kong gei-ah ahi a, khuasung mun sangpen ah ahi zongin tu a,
ama kiang a nawkkha, amau’ nasep bek a phawk kimlai mite kiangah,
“Thu thei lote aw, hong pai un,” ci-in samin, mihaite kiangah,
Tui dawnsim, khum diak a, annek sim, lim diak hi,” ci hi.
Tua lai-a a paite a sihna thu, tua lai-a lutsate sihna gamthuk sungah a om khitna thu, a khem zawh mite in phawk kha lo uh hi.
